value.syntax: # [doc = " An origin command's explicit result after its callback has run."] pub enum OriginCallbackOutcome < Output , Error > { # [doc = " Emit one complete stdout result and return success."] Success (Output) , # [doc = " Emit the existing public control record and return a terminal refusal."] TerminalRefusal (ControlPlaneRecord) , # [doc = " Report an ordinary runtime failure."] RuntimeFailure (Error) , }
